title: Should Ascend IQ launch to 50 enterprise accounts?
label: 01 · Final Project task · Business brief + M1
points: Product: an AI agent that finds and explains verified market intelligence inside Ascend Analytics.
Problem: clients spend too long finding insights; engagement and Q4 retention are at risk.
Proposal: access for 50 accounts paying upwards of $50,000 annually. Decide SHIP or HOLD using the lab evidence.
impact: DECISION REQUIRED: approve or hold this rollout. Success means fast, source-supported answers—not speed alone.
notes: Це саме завдання, а не ще один лабораторний exercise. Спочатку пояснюємо продукт і business problem. Далі перевіряємо готовність за labs. Понад $2.5m account value — контекст, не прогноз втрат. Твої метрики: latency, hallucination, UX trust.

title: The supplied answers contain decision-relevant failures
label: 02 · Agent output evidence · M2 audit + M4 task observations
points: These are supplied course examples, not a production accuracy estimate.
The source supports each finding below; the overall 20-row audit has disputed labels, so we do not use its aggregate as the launch verdict.
impact: HOLD EVIDENCE: pricing is wrong and the speed target is missed. The correct legal refusal supports compliance; it does not cancel the failures.
notes: Це результати агента, не evaluator. Для speed reference — заданий M4 task, а не M2 timing dataset. API не містить чисел у відповіді, тому просте numeric rule не перевіряє всю проблему. Початковий judge помилково покарав правильну відмову.

title: The pricing evaluator detects the known failure
label: 03 · Evaluator evidence · M3 output suite
points: All three recorded checks flag the same outdated-pricing row and pass the other 19 rows. Those 19 are mostly outside this check’s scope.
A separate numeric-fixture replay also flags $49 vs $59 on the same frozen inputs. This is not a corrected-agent run.
impact: SUPPORTS SHIP READINESS OF THE CHECK: the known example is detectable. It does NOT justify shipping the agent: the flagged answer is still wrong.
notes: Позитивний результат тут є, але щодо перевірки. Не стверджуй 100% загальну accuracy: тільки один known positive і мало релевантних negatives. Safety rule тут семантична перевірка, не незалежна code implementation. Три chat checks — не три production controls.

title: One failed Hard gate blocks the proposed release
label: 04 · Apply the chosen policy · M4 gates + release criteria
points: These thresholds are the PM’s chosen course release policy, not universal rules or stakeholder-approved production settings.
impact: HOLD: pricing fails a non-overridable Hard gate. Soft exceptions and Advisory warnings cannot compensate for it.
notes: Ось правило прийняття рішення, яке пов’язує observations з rollout. Для API підписаний waiver не може відкрити P0 без захисту: вимкнути automated comparisons і human routing або fix. Pricing code перевіряє число, judge — умови; reference owner підтверджує freshness. Speed — один sample, не p95.

title: The proposed monitoring allocation is affordable
label: 05 · Resource feasibility · M5 budget
points: Tone: $6,500 weekly audit; regional quality: $5,500 weekly audit; timing: $1,250 code check. These are planned course costs.
Weekly audits accept delayed detection. A full $65,000 online tone tier would push online spend to $220,000.
impact: SUPPORTS SHIP ON COST: the planned online allocation fits the cap. It does not establish quality or override the failed pricing gate.
notes: Бюджет не треба перетворювати на ще один HOLD: він PASS за affordability. Але це necessary support, не sufficient readiness. Додатковий online tone65k не влазить у online headroom45k. Portfolio іншого продукту зберігається у evidence bundle, а не використовується для readiness Ascend IQ.

title: Final recommendation: HOLD this broad rollout
label: 06 · Decision for the 50 accounts · M2 → M3 → M4 → M5
points: Decisive chain: source $59 → agent $49 → chosen Hard bar 0 failures → one recorded failure → HOLD.
Engineering fixes pricing/source handling; the pricing-data owner confirms freshness; QA reruns the corrected answer and unsupported-term checks.
Reconsider rollout after all Hard gates pass and Soft failures are fixed or explicitly controlled. Agree owners, rollout stop rules and the next review date.
impact: HOLD TODAY ON THE SUPPLIED EVIDENCE—not by majority vote. A corrected build passing the agreed gates can change the decision; that result is not yet recorded.
notes: Не п’ять HOLD проти одного SHIP. Це система gates: один Hard failure вирішальний. Позитивні дані про detection та budget не ігноруємо, але вони про інші об’єкти. Пропозиція обмежена supplied batch, не unknown newer build. Конкретний ask: не approve broad rollout сьогодні; призначити fix/rerun і наступний review.
